title.official: Plaintiff’s reply to third party defence

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.54(1)  A plaintiff or third party plaintiff may file a reply to a
statement of defence filed by a third party defendant.
(2)  If a plaintiff or third party plaintiff files a reply, the reply must
(a) be in Form 20,
(b) comply with the rules about pleadings in Part 13, Division
3, and
(c) be filed and served on the third party defendant and each
of the other parties within 10 days after service of the
statement of defence by the third party defendant on the
plaintiff.

BOOK_C.title: Plaintiff’s reply to third party defence
BOOK_C.operative_text_raw:
(1) A plaintiff or third party plaintiff may file a reply to a statement of defence filed by a third party defendant.
(2) If a plaintiff or third party plaintiff files a reply, the reply must (a) be in Form 20, (b) comply with the rules about pleadings in Part 13 [Technical Rules], Division 3 , and [Pleadings]
(c) be filed and served on the third party defendant and each of the other parties within 10 days after service of the statement of defence by the third party defendant on the plaintiff.

commentary.text: Importantly, the plaintiff or third party plaintiff may reply to a statement of defence filed by a third party defendant. This is important in cases where the third party has defended the third party claim by denying the defendant’s liability to the plaintiff. The plaintiff has the right to respond to the third party’s pleadings about why the defendant is not liable to the plaintiff.
